name: Hotel Olympia
beschreibung: The Hotel Olympia in Tirol, Österreich, is characterized by a quiet location in the alpine surroundings. The atmosphere of the house combines traditional architecture with modern amenities. A central offering is the wellness area with indoor pool and sauna complex. Half board includes a breakfast buffet and a dinner menu with regional and international dishes. The hotel is a suitable starting point for hikes in summer and ski trips in winter. The rooms are functionally and comfortably furnished; some offer balconies with mountain views. Overall, guests can expect a well-run hotel for an active or relaxing stay
